title: My Friends
text:
My friend Ana is very kind. She is funny and she always makes me laugh. She is also very smart. She helps me with my homework.

My brother Pedro is shy. He does not talk a lot in class. But he is very honest. He always tells the truth.

questions.text: How is Ana described in paragraph one?
What does Pedro do in class?
options: He does not talk a lot

questions.text: Why does the writer like Ana?
options: She helps the writer and makes the writer laugh

questions.text: What kind of person is Pedro probably?
options: a person who is very loud
a person who is always angry

vocabulary.definition: nice and caring towards other people
does not feel comfortable talking to other people

paragraph_translations: Minha amiga Ana é muito gentil. Ela é engraçada e sempre me faz rir. Ela também é muito inteligente. Ela me ajuda com a lição de casa.
Meu irmão Pedro é tímido. Ele não fala muito na aula. Mas ele é muito honesto. Ele sempre diz a verdade.
